# ankra_node_group (Resource)

A node group of a cluster Ankra provisioned (Hetzner, OVHcloud, UpCloud, DigitalOcean, Scaleway, AWS, Proxmox VE, HPE Morpheus or Ankra Cloud). The counterpart of `ankra cluster node-group add|delete`, and of `scale`, `upgrade`, `labels`, `taints` and `autoscaling set` for in-place changes: `node_count`, `instance_type`, `labels`, `taints` and `autoscaling` update the running group without replacing it. Each change is submitted and then waited for until the group's listing shows it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_node_group" "gpu" {
  cluster_id    = ankra_hetzner_cluster.example.cluster_id
  name          = "gpu"
  instance_type = "cx42"
  node_count    = 2

  labels = {
    accelerator = "gpu"
  }
  taints = [{
    key    = "gpu"
    effect = "NoSchedule"
  }]

  # Building or draining nodes takes minutes; each change is waited for.
  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
    update = "30m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the group belongs to. Changing it replaces the group.
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type (server type, size, plan or flavor, in the cloud's vocabulary; a plan id for HPE Morpheus). Changing it resizes every node in place: the platform drains and power-cycles each one.
- `name` (String) Group name, unique within the cluster. Changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `autoscaling` (Attributes) Cluster Autoscaler bounds of the group. Updated in place; removing the block disables autoscaling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling))
- `availability_zone` (String) Pin every node to one availability zone (OVHcloud 3-AZ regions).
- `force_drain` (Boolean) Drain nodes a scale-down, resize or delete removes without honouring their pods' PodDisruptionBudgets. Defaults to `false`. Affects future changes only.
- `labels` (Map of String) Kubernetes labels of the group's nodes. Updated in place.
- `node_count` (Number) Number of nodes (the API's `count`; `count` itself is reserved by Terraform). The platform defaults it to 1. Changing it scales the group in place. While `autoscaling` is enabled the Cluster Autoscaler owns the live count, so drift in it is not reported; leave `node_count` unset then.
- `taints` (Attributes List) Kubernetes taints of the group's nodes. Updated in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--taints))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Cloud-init document applied at first boot of every node the group creates (OVHcloud only). The platform does not return it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Changing it replaces the group.
- `zone` (String) Pin every node to one zone of an UpCloud multi-zone cluster's pool.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_kind` (String) Kind of the cluster (`hetzner`, `aws`, ...), resolved from the platform; it selects the API lane.
- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<name>`.

<a id="nestedatt--autoscaling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autoscaling`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Cluster Autoscaler manages the node count.
- `max_count` (Number) Upper bound of the node count.
- `min_count` (Number) Lower bound of the node count (at least 1).


<a id="nestedatt--taints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `taints`

Required:

- `effect` (String) `NoSchedule`, `PreferNoSchedule` or `NoExecute`.
- `key` (String) Taint key.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Taint value. Defaults to empty.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Node groups are imported by <cluster_id>/<name>.
terraform import ankra_node_group.gpu ef8cf93e-1d97-4494-9de4-12ced709ffde/gpu
```
